title: Egg Curry with {v}
steps: Boil the eggs hard: lower them into boiling water for 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Soften a little garlic in oil, then bloom the {spice} for 30 seconds.
Add the {v} and the {sauce} and simmer 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Halve the eggs, slip them into the sauce to warm through, and serve over the {s}.
tip: Eggs are a cheap, filling protein: load the sauce with veg and go easy on the oil.
